en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a stone monument in a landscaped city park. The monument is a rectangular structure with two front columns and a small roof featuring a crenellated edge. In the center is a round medallion relief portrait of a person. Low stone walls and metal railings frame the monument, with paths and dense trees in the background and a small palm-like plant in the foreground. Red printed captions in German appear at the top of the card.
